warnings.message: Measure v1_empty on source v1_rollups uses #@ preaggregate, which is deprecated: its v2 spelling is #(preaggregate) grain=[…] (see https://github.com/malloydata/publisher/blob/main/docs/materialization-migration.md). Until you switch, #@ preaggregate still builds and serves its rollups.
warnings.subject: v1_rollups

warnings.message: Measure `v1_empty` declares `#@ preaggregate storage=""` with no destination. Name the storage destination the rollup should be built into, or remove the key to build it alongside its base.
warnings.subject: v1_empty
